newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee seen at 35.70/74 vs dlr on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee seen at 35.70/74 vs dlr on Monday.

text.p: The Indian rupee is expected to move in a 35.70/74 range against the dollar on Monday, dealers said.
"The rupee has found a new range, with Reserve Bank of India (RBI) support at 35.70/71 and export hammering capping the upside," a European bank said in a commentary.

"We are looking at a range of 35.7050/7400 for some time now." The bank was referring to RBI's intervention on Friday after the rupee broke through the 35.70 psychological barrier to trade at 35.69 against the dollar.
Spot rupee opened steady at 35.71/72 against the dollar and was unchanged in early Monday trade, dealers said.
But some dealers said the RBI was vigorously defending the 35.81/82 level a few months ago, but allowed the rupee to slip that barrier to the new-found benchmark of 35.70/71.
"The market is confused as there are clear signals from the RBI," the dealer said.
Dealers said they expected forward dollar premiums to open lower on Monday on easy call money rates. Call rates were trading at 1.5-2.0 percent on Monday.
"We expect some export covering to resume now that the rupee has stabilised," dealers said.
